title: AiCreation
description: ai.creation@1: one thing AI can make on OpenVibe, as the catalogue lists it. GET /api/v1/creations (public, cached, CORS open) answers every creation that is live now, built from OpenVibe.AI's registered workflows and tasks: a creation appears only while the workflow or task behind it is active, so a paused or retired workflow leaves the list. `gives` and `returns` are the person-facing sentences, not the workflow's JSON schema. `workflow` names the AI workflow that does the work; `task` names a registered AI task when the creation is a task rather than a workflow (the task's own workflow still does the work). At least one of them is set. `access` says who may start it: a guest, a signed-in person, and whether the 18+ floor applies. `costs_coins` says a run may charge the person's OpenVibe balance after their free allowance. `start_url` is where a person starts it.

id.description: Stable id, never reused: the catalogue's key for this creation.

product.description: The OpenVibe product the result lands in.

name.description: One plain line a person reads, in the imperative: "Write a blog post".

gives.description: What the person gives it, in plain words (a topic, a picture, a listing, source links).

returns.description: What comes back, in plain words (a draft, an article, a set of files, a check).

workflow.description: The OpenVibe.AI workflow key that does the work (for example blog.draft_post), or null when the creation is only a registered task.

task.description: A registered AI task key (for example design.icon), or null when the creation is the workflow itself.

guest.description: A person who is not signed in may start it.

signed_in.description: A signed-in person may start it.

costs_coins.description: A run may charge the person's OpenVibe balance after their free allowance; false only when it is free to them.
